scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix desktop install && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ui,app "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm --prefix desktop run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix desktop run test:e2e
